---
name: Partner listing
about: Ask to be listed on https://autoagentprotocol.org/partners
labels: partners
---

**Organization name** (exactly as it should appear)


**Site** (one https URL; add a second only for another property of the same organization)


**What you do with AAP** (one or two sentences: which agent, which of the five skills, which contract version, or which upstream specification you maintain)


**Public evidence** (agent card URL, docs page, release, or announcement — a listing needs a link anyone can check)


Listings are free, require no reciprocal link, and are not an endorsement. Maintainers review each request, and may decline a listing or remove one whose public evidence no longer resolves. Accepted entries go into `partners.json`; alphabetical order and link rules are enforced by `pnpm run validate:partners`.
